# Public product homepage

## Scope

2026-11-18. User-requested static English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese homepage based on existing functions and usage scenarios, the official website of the repository's UI reference, language-specific imagery, and sign-in only after selecting its entry point. This changes public entry/navigation, not authentication semantics or domain permissions. Relates to existing P0 login and S1/S3 record/publication workflows, plus implemented P1 S2/S4 preparation and opportunity presentation.

## Implementation

- `/` lazy-loads `HomePage.vue` without an owner meta flag or session request. All sign-in actions target the existing `/login`. Owner routes keep their existing guard.
- Existing language catalogs and selector supply homepage copy, document title, labels and image alternative text. Three views by three languages yield nine local JPEG images. Switching language keeps the selected preview.
- The layout follows the official [shadcn-vue homepage](https://www.shadcn-vue.com/) and the [two-part design pack](../../design/2026-11-18-homepage/README.md). Product images depict clearly fictional, localized examples; no real owner data or model output was used.
- Three keyboard-accessible tabs expose record, preparation and sharing previews. Full-size image links support narrow devices. Anchor navigation reaches product, use cases and privacy. No provider, database or schema changes were needed.

## Verification

- `npm run build`: passed TypeScript and production asset compilation.
- `npm run test:i18n`: passed three catalogs with 599 messages each, parameter parity and production-template coverage.
- `npx playwright test tests/e2e/homepage.spec.ts`: **16 passed**. Includes public root with no API request, explicit sign-in navigation, localized heading/title/image, language persistence, keyboard selection, and anchors. A controlled unauthenticated session response verifies that private-route navigation still reaches login; no backend authorization change is claimed or tested by that interception.
- Layout matrix: English/Chinese/Japanese at 1440, 768, 390 and 320px; all three images per combination load at their expected native dimensions; no page exceptions, horizontal document overflow or out-of-viewport controls/headings.
- Browser/IAB directly verified the public root, locale selector, preview selection, sign-in form and return-home path. Its viewport override did not affect the selected tab, so the existing Playwright Chromium runner provided responsive dimensions and final captures.
- Native concept viewports checked at 1402 by 1122 and 1487 by 1058. Both generated concept files and the latest full-page browser renders were opened with `view_image` for direct comparison. Mobile Japanese at 320px and Chinese at 390px were separately inspected.
- Backend/AI suites were not rerun: no server/domain/model code changed. The page does not submit a login or create an account merely by being viewed. No deployment or commit was performed by this task.

## Visual comparison ledger

| Point | Concept and final render evidence | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hierarchy | Two-line centered heading, short explanatory text and paired actions precede the product preview | Desktop hero raised to 80px; preserved hierarchy |
| Copy | Brand, three nav anchors, sign-in, hero/description, preview labels and illustrative caption match the allowed copy inventory | No extra visible above-fold marketing text; whitespace between heading lines corrected |
| Palette | White canvas, dark text, forest-green heading, emerald actions and pale mint privacy band | Preserved; no tint over product images or decorative gradient |
| Layout | Wide framed product preview, open use-case columns and thin separators, then privacy and closing action | Preserved; 1300px shared content width |
| Icons | Book, conversation, share, shield, checks and directional arrows use the application's outline family | Consistent stroke and colors; retained existing Lucide primitives |
| Imagery | Fictional contribution, linked evidence and cited answer reflect the concept | Exact-language HTML-rendered images replace generated UI text; 1200:560 ratio retains CJK content |
| Responsive | Mobile stacks use cases and actions while retaining all copy | Narrow Japanese header/navigation repaired; full-size images available |
| Interaction | Real HTML links and keyboard-operable tabs sit outside raster illustrations | Verified in IAB and automated browser cases |

Intentional adaptations are the taller multilingual product image, two additional workflow images, the fictional owner/source-scope note inside imagery, standard application typography, and mobile reflow. Within these recorded adaptations, the implemented page faithfully retains the chosen concept's hierarchy, palette, section order and component treatment. No unresolved clipping, broken asset, incorrect language or routing issue was observed.
